extensions.source: Web: apps/web/src/styles/app.css (:root light, .dark, .on-felt, .type-sky/.type-sun/.type-pink; the older role names there are aliases of the board roles). Phone: apps/mobile/src/theme/colors.ts (light + dark, typeTone). Frontmatter keys dark-* are the .dark values of the same roles; phone-* are values only the phone has or where it differs. Tonal ramps are built from the project's own steps of each family (ink, track, felt, page), not synthesised, so most are shorter than 8 steps.

page.note: The ground of every screen; deep night blue in dark, never black.

felt.note: Every neutral card, the sidebar, search, quiet buttons, fields on the page.

track.note: Segmented tracks, empty beads, quiet fills on a felt card.

raised.note: Thumbs, secondary buttons, active nav item, avatars and fields on felt, menus.

ink-3.note: Lowest text ink; 4.53:1 on track in light.

mute.note: Never text: planned bead rings, empty seat rings, closed days.

fill.note: The one filled button per area; white on it is 4.9:1.

amber.note: Needs-your-action only; a dot and ink, never a fill.

now-chip.note: White words in light, #2a0b17 in dark.

page-title.purpose: One per page; 28/36 below 1024px. Today's title is the date.

money.purpose: Finance's amount to share; ₺ at 34/500. 44/52 below 640px.

big-count.purpose: A child's lessons left; amber ink when low.

hero-time.purpose: The running or next lesson's time on Today; 32/40 below 1024px.

figure.purpose: The number on a figure tile.

period.purpose: Money period or week name; first letter capitalised.

summary.purpose: One sentence under the page title, ink-2, max 72ch.

body.purpose: Rows and buttons; names at 500. Root size 14/1.45.

sub.purpose: Sub-lines, descriptions, card footers in ink-3.

label.purpose: Marks, counts, group heads (600 ink-2) and column heads (12.5/500 at 80%).

phone-figure.purpose: Times, counts and amounts in tiles and right columns (stat tiles 24).

phone-section.purpose: Section heads outside the card, with a 14pt ink-3 aside.

phone-headline.purpose: Lesson type line, sheet title, period name.

phone-sub.purpose: Sub-lines under a row's title; group labels at 600 ink-2.

phone-foot.purpose: Weekdays, legends, hour labels. Nothing under 11pt.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A piece lifted off the felt: thumbs, secondary buttons, the active nav item, the search key, people chips, switch knobs.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Sheets, menus, popovers, toasts, the web glass tab bar.

shadows.name: phone-float
shadows.purpose: The phone's 44pt glass round buttons and toasts.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and focus on controls; press scales to 0.98 (cards and tiles 0.99).

motion.name: thumb-slide
motion.purpose: Segment and attendance thumbs; on the phone the bead fills at the same moment, with a light haptic.

motion.name: sheet-in-right
motion.purpose: Web sheet from the right (768px and up).

motion.name: sheet-out-down
motion.purpose: Web sheet dropping away on phones.

motion.name: peg-in
motion.purpose: An initials circle settling after attendance is marked.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Web skeletons; the phone breathes opacity over 900ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation collapses under prefers-reduced-motion; the phone skips the breath.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Sheets move from the bottom to the right.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar and top bar replace the glass tab bar; md buttons drop from 44 to 40px.

touch.method: Web: pointer: coarse ::after extension on controls under 44px. Phone: hitSlop to 44pt (48dp on Android).

narrative.overview:
The workshop's sensory classroom has a felt board: soft, matte pieces in a few colours laid on a plain ground. The panel is that board. The page is plain white (deep night blue in the dark, never black). Content sits on matte felt cards: filled, borderless, shadowless, generously rounded. The logo's three colours are not decoration; they are the material of the lessons: İngilizce is sky felt, Duyusal sunshine felt, Özel pink felt, each with an ink of its own hue. Everything that is not a lesson is neutral felt. Small things you press or that stand for a person are lifted pieces: white pills and circles with a soft lift.

Two surfaces share one token table and one vocabulary. The web panel (Vite, React, Tailwind 4) floats a felt sidebar beside the page and opens work in a felt sheet at the right. The iPhone app (Expo) keeps the phone's own chrome: the floating glass tab bar, native page sheets, native pickers and switches; everything inside them is the same felt board. Type is Geologica on both, set big and confident for times, counts and money, always in tabular figures.

Density is a working tool's: readable between lessons, everything opens on the current day, week or money period, and time-shaped data is drawn as time (the day ribbon, the week board, the child's period calendar, the period strip). The public parents' calendar (`/takvim`, `apps/web/src/public-calendar`) keeps its own look and is outside this system.
keyCharacteristics: A plain page; matte felt cards with no border and no shadow, 26px round.
Lessons carry their type as material (tinted felt + a shape), so a lesson reads at a glance and without colour.
One filled blue button per area; amber only for "do something"; an absent lesson is red with an X.
Geologica 400/500/600/700, big tabular figures, sentence case everywhere.
Shadows only on lifted pieces and on what floats (sidebar pieces, menus, sheets, the glass tab bar).

rules.name: The Lesson Is the Material Rule
rules.body: A lesson-type colour fills a whole surface only for that lesson (Today's hero, next-lesson tiles, calendar blocks, the chosen type tile). Anything that is not a lesson is neutral felt.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: One Deep Blue filled button per area. No black fills, no second accent, no violet.

rules.name: The Amber Means Act Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where the admin has something to do. Nothing decorative is amber.

rules.name: The Absence Is Seen Rule
rules.body: Attended green with a check, absent red with an X (red fill and a white X on beads and calendar badges, red wash and red ink on chips and pegs), make-up pink, forgotten amber. The owner asked for absences to be seen at a glance (2026-10-29), so red here means did not come, not an error.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: The whole admin body is set in tabular figures; every time, count and amount lines up.

rules.name: The Turkish Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts are typed and shown the Turkish way in every interface language (13.850 or 13.850,50 followed by ₺).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case; no uppercase labels, no eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The One Container Rule
rules.body: The felt card is the container. Inside it, groups are label rows and line-divided rows, never a card inside a card.

rules.name: The Current Period Rule
rules.body: Today opens on today, Calendar on the current week, Finance on the money period that holds today; time-based data is drawn as time before it is listed.

rules.name: The Matte Felt Rule
rules.body: If it is a card, it is filled and flat. A shadow means "lifted piece" or "floating layer", never a coloured glow.

rules.name: The Round Piece Rule
rules.body: Things you press are pills; people are circles; containers are soft felt rectangles.

dos: Do use the roles in `apps/web/src/styles/app.css` (`page`, `felt`, `track`, `raised`, `ink-*`, `fill`, the `type-sky / type-sun / type-pink` classes) and `apps/mobile/src/theme/colors.ts` (`typeTone`); the older role names there are aliases, not a second palette.
Do build pages from Page, Card (with `tone` for a lesson), Band, Figure tiles, CardTabs, Section and Sheet.
Do give a lesson its type's felt and shape, and everything else neutral felt.
Do keep one Deep Blue (#0077b3) filled button per area and amber for "needs your action" only.
Do set figures big and tabular, and amounts in Turkish format in all three languages.
Do keep every control a pill with a 44px touch area on touch screens.
Do use the phone's own chrome (glass tab bar, native page sheets, pickers, switches, action sheets, haptics).
Do keep motion short (thumb 180ms, sheet 240ms, press 0.98–0.99) and honour reduced motion.
Do check every screen in light and dark.
donts: Don't give a card a border or a shadow, or put a card inside a card.
Don't use black fills, violet, gradients, gradient text or glow shadows; the hatch and the loading shimmer are the only gradients.
Don't colour an absence red or fill a status with a solid block.
Don't add side-stripe accents, uppercase labels or eyebrows above headings.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons; icons are Phosphor on the web and SF Symbols on the phone.
Don't introduce a second type family or a second accent hue.
Don't paint over the iPhone's tab bar or draw its glass yourself.
Don't restyle the public parents' calendar (`/takvim`) from this file; it keeps its own look.
